question: Bharatiya Bhasha Pustak Scheme has been launched in Budget 2025. Which ministry is implementing it?
solution: The correct answer is __**Ministry of Education**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Bharatiya Bhasha Pustak Scheme** was introduced in the **Budget 2025** with the aim of promoting Indian languages and literature across diverse regions of India. • The scheme is being implemented under the **Ministry of Education**, which is tasked with fostering cultural and linguistic diversity in the educational ecosystem. • The scheme focuses on creating educational materials and books in regional Indian languages, contributing to the vision of the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**, which emphasizes multilingual education. • The initiative seeks to empower students by providing access to educational resources in their native languages, thereby enhancing inclusivity and learning outcomes. • The **Ministry of Education** plays a pivotal role in coordinating with state governments, educational institutions, and publishers to ensure the successful implementation of this scheme.
